name: Danna no Tsurego ga Hen Nan Desu! ~Nerawareta Houman Tsuma~
original_name: 旦那の連れ子が変なんです！ ～狙われた豊満妻～
source:
Saako married a man who had a child from a previous marriage.
After quitting her job to become a full-time housewife,
Saako spent a lot of time alone with Ren, her stepchild.

At first, she actively tried to communicate with him
in an effort to get along, but Ren seemed somewhat aloof.

However, as they spent more time together,
Ren’s strange behavior began to catch her attention…

“What are you doing?
Well then, spread your legs and show me right now…”

“No… please don’t stare so much…”

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/pro/work/=/product_id/VJ01004924.html/]dlsite[/url]]
translation:
纱亚子嫁给了一位带着前妻孩子再婚的男人。
辞去工作成为全职主妇后，
纱亚子每天都有大把时间与继子莲在家中独处。

起初，为了和继子融洽相处，
她一直积极主动地找他搭话交流，莲的态度却始终有些冷淡疏离。

然而随着两人相处的时间越来越长，
莲种种古怪反常的举动开始引起了她的注意……

“你在干什么呀？
那就赶紧把腿张开，现在就给我看看吧……”

“不要……求你别这么死盯着看……”
